item.title: Overworld 0.2.2
item.description:
• Overworld has a new mark: the brass bell from the town's clock tower, on the app icon, in the menu bar and in the opening title. In the menu bar it shows a slash when the hook is not installed.
  • A new notice board, opened from the Hall, lists each house's agents, working, asleep or finished for now, with the bells waiting on you first. When a manager session writes a task file, its subagents' rows also show a rough finish time.
  • If the opening film doesn't play at launch, Overworld now notes why in the system log.
